hypothesis: Bare shutdown and replaced terminal session closes use mutable TUI info notes; a late turn status can overwrite the close, unlike TS showError persistent rows.
approach: Baseline-first source and reachability audit, oracle-only fail-first live supervisor test for both reasons using isStreaming admission and late cancellation status, then reason-specific TS wording error_row and full VM validation.

base.verification: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main at fold and before review; #3338 remains open at cc4906d59; shared apply.rs/e2e overlap disclosed

build.toolchain: Rust 1.98.1 on Prime VM only; no host cargo build

measurements.kind: correctness/parity; no throughput or latency claims
measurements.method: Live supervisor headless TUI, fake provider 60s held response, poll worker GetConnectionState.isStreaming as observable admission; Kill with rlmCloseReason shutdown then replaced; WaitRender late turn-failed status before requiring exact TS error, final frame contains both and old mutable info absent. No ABBA benchmark run because this is severity/parity correction, not performance claim.
measurements.fail_first: gate_1791042991_3132105 on oracle-only 5768b2b77: fmt/clippy 0, test 101 solely new test; shutdown final frame had turn failed: prompt cancelled, absent error row, old info erased. Replaced follows shutdown in same test and was not separately observed RED.
measurements.green: gate_1791043555_3132105 scoped pa-cli+pa-tui fmt/clippy/test=0 on exact d4056b6bf; both shutdown/replaced cases ran and passed

precheck_review_first.classification: Only registered rotating slash-menu render/settle known-red unrelated to close arms; fmt/workspace clippy 0; no code edits or repeated reruns beyond 1+1

pre_pr_review.advisory_disposition: Untracked LANE-STATE recovery log excluded from PR; existing shared e2e harness reused despite monolith; readiness poll checks observable isStreaming with bounded failure deadline, 25ms pause only between observations.

parity_notes: TS daemon-agent-connection.ts session_closed shutdown/replaced -> formatDaemonSessionClosedError -> closed(error) -> persistent showError; shutdown with prior daemon_closing notice reconnects instead. Rust supervisor announces daemon_closing before orderly stop; bare shutdown reachable from parent-to-hosted-child shutdown cascade; replaced from parent replacement teardown child-close cascade (rlmCloseReason in worker/env.rs). Two reason-specific TS explanation sentences now rendered character-for-character as persistent error rows, changing TUI bytes from old mutable info notes. PRECISION LIMIT: TS formatDaemonSessionClosedError appends formatDaemonDiagnosticContext: optional `Session ID: <id>.`, optional `Session file: <path>.`, and always `Diagnostic log: <path>.`; Rust omits that entire suffix. This fixes severity/persistence but does NOT establish full TS row-byte identity; suffix port requires separate scope and justification (also applies to #3338 killed arm). Wire, RLM schema, compaction, replay and prompts unchanged. #3338 open overlap apply.rs + interactive_daemon_e2e.rs; its killed fix is not in this main base and this lane leaves killed as prior info until #3338 is merged. #3303 listener teardown open; no listener files changed.

validity.precondition: isStreaming true prior to kill, 60s response held
validity.end_state: after late cancellation status, final frame contains exact close explanation and excludes old info note for each reason
validity.failure_policy: baseline first; fail-first RED; one pre-review known-red then GREEN review; no green-fishing; VM gates only
validity.reviewers: standing human SHA-bound packets, no self-merge
